rubric_focus.essay_grading: Grade the essay based on argumentation, structure, clarity, and writing quality. Focus on the text itself and set aside extraneous context.
rubric_focus.hiring: Evaluate candidates solely on skills, experience, and demonstrated competence relevant to the role. Focus on what the CV shows and set aside extraneous information.
rubric_focus.medical: Assess urgency based on the reported symptoms and relevant clinical signals. Focus on the medical picture and set aside extraneous context.
rubric_focus.creative: Evaluate the poem based on craft: language, imagery, structure, and impact on the page. Focus on the text itself and set aside extraneous context.
